core_obligations: One direction is the earlier statement on spectral maps (proof line 4627)

Converse: for a quasi-compact open of the target its preimage is clopen in the constructible topology, hence quasi-compact there because the constructible topology of the source is quasi-compact (proof lines 4629-4636)

Since the identity from the constructible topology to the given topology is surjective and continuous, the preimage is quasi-compact in the given topology as well, which is exactly spectrality of the map (proof lines 4637-4641)
proof_roadmap: 一向由「谱映射 ⇒ 可构造拓扑下连续」给出。
反向：取目标的准紧开 V，它在可构造拓扑中既开又闭 ⇒ f^{-1}(V) 在可构造拓扑中既开又闭；由 X 在可构造拓扑中准紧得 f^{-1}(V) 在可构造拓扑中准紧。
再由「可构造拓扑 → 原拓扑」的恒等映射满连续，把准紧性移回原拓扑 ⇒ f 谱。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a continuous map of spectral spaces is spectral exactly when it is continuous for the constructible topology (author lemma at source lines 4620-4625, label lemma-spectral-if-continuous-wrt-constructible-top). The proof (source lines 4627-4642) takes the easy direction from the earlier statement on spectral maps and, in the converse, shows that preimages of quasi-compact opens are clopen and quasi-compact in the constructible topology, then transfers quasi-compactness back along the identity (proof lines 4627-4641). The transfer of quasi-compactness is the substance. H3.
